text: On 31 December N, the Parent Company acquired 100% of the Subsidiary. title: Company Kerris – office building
text: Kerris bought an office building for its own use for €3,000,000 on 31 December N; useful life 12 years, straight-line depreciation, no residual value.
On 31 December N+3 the building is impaired down to its recoverable amount of €1,800,000. On 31 December N+5 a new impairment test shows that the recoverable amount has risen to €2,300,000.

title: Company Fennick – how to finance new equipment
text: Fennick needs new equipment with a useful life of 8 years. The CFO considers three alternatives:
A – take out a bank loan and buy the equipment;
B – lease the equipment for 7 years (lease contract under IFRS 16);
C – sign a service contract under which a supplier provides the required capacity with equipment the supplier chooses and may replace at any time.
